text.p: Eastco Industrial Safety Corp said Tuesday that its Safety Wear Corp unit will expand its manufacture of industrial coveralls in the Republic of Mexico.
The company said the move will double its basic disposable clothing capacity.
The company said the new operations will provide continued growth in a market where demand remains strong and profitable.

The company said it believes that proposed federal legislation, particularly in the area of clean-up of super fund toxic waste sites, will increase demand for its products during and beyond the fiscal year to begin July 1.
